candidates.name: Neurofibroma

candidates.name: Dermatofibroma

selector.rationale: Multiple subcutaneous, nontender, mobile swellings with spindle cells having bipolar cytoplasmic extensions and round-to-oval nuclei support Neurofibroma, which is a more specific diagnosis given the clinical presentation and cytological features.

rejected.label: Dermatofibroma
rejected.why: While it shares some features like firm to hard lesions and moderate cellularity, the presence of bipolar cytoplasmic extensions in spindle cells and the specific pattern of subcutaneous swellings are more indicative of Neurofibroma.
